camel_example: aliyun iot SpeechBySynthesis --region cn-hangzhou --Text test --AudioFormat wav --Voice Siyue
description_en: Sends dynamic text-to-speech content to a device for playback
description_zh: 调用该接口下发动态播报内容到设备进行播报
kebab_example: aliyun iot speech-by-synthesis --voice Siyue --text test --audio-format wav --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SpeechBySynthesis

parameters.help_en: The voice for speech playback, which is preset by the system, such as standard female voice or standard male voice. You can query available voice types by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html and use the Value in VoiceList from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html进行查询，填入返回参数中0中1的值
parameters.name: voice

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html to obtain this parameter.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device, and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID，该参数可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html获取。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The speech rate. Valid values: -500 to 500
parameters.name: speech_rate

parameters.help_en: The text content. This parameter is required when the speech type is set to custom. The text supports English letters, Chinese characters, and spaces. The length is 1 to 100 characters. A Chinese character occupies two characters
parameters.help_zh: 语料文本，当语料类型选择为自定义语料时，该参数必选。语料文本支持英文字母、汉字和空格，长度为1~100个字符，一个汉字占两个字符
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh: 设备所属的产品ProductKey。如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
设备的DeviceName。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The unique speech ID sent to the device.
<notice>
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates one. If you retry a speech playback for business purposes, specify the speech ID of the retry to avoid duplicate playback.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
下发给设备的唯一播报ID。
<notice>
若不传入则由系统生成，若业务上进行重试播报，需传入重试的播报ID，避免出现重复业务播报。
</notice>
parameters.name: speech_id

parameters.help_en: The audio format. Only wav, mp3, and amr formats are supported
parameters.name: audio_format

parameters.help_en: The volume level. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: An internal error occurred. Try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
